tasks.answer: Use DeleteDiscussion, the destructive confirmation control for deleting a discussion; it only needs the discussion id. The generic shared primitive behind such prompts is ui.dialog.confirmation-dialog.ConfirmationDialog (triggerButton, confirmButton, title).

The login form uses ui.form.Input. It binds react-hook-form through the required registration prop, typed Partial<UseFormRegisterReturn>: pass the result of register('email') / register('password'), which Input spreads onto the native input. It must live inside Form (Form provides the RHF context and FieldWrapper supplies label/error).
The discussions list paginates with TablePagination, a page-number control that builds hrefs from rootUrl plus the current page; it requires totalPages, currentPage and rootUrl.
MDPreview safely renders Markdown as sanitized HTML with prose typography; the Markdown source is passed in the required value prop.
CreateDiscussion is the drawer form that creates a discussion (title plus Markdown body). It is admin-only, so it requires the admin role/permission.

notes: Strategy: one search per task (all five answered component id, importPath and required props directly); one extra targeted get only for ui.form.Input --prop registration to explain the react-hook-form binding. No project source files read and no catalog JSON read; only the skill usage doc was consulted for CLI syntax before searching. Budget held: 5 searches, 1 get, no repeated IDs, no --include props.
